# Code of Conduct

rebake follows the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

Be kind, assume good faith, and keep discussion about the work. Harassment of any kind isn't tolerated.

Report unacceptable behaviour to [contact@florentinf.dev](mailto:contact@florentinf.dev). Reports are handled privately, and the maintainer may remove comments, close discussions or block accounts that break these rules.
